corrects.the_defect: the enumerator, not the vocabulary. (1) it admitted only terms whose TEXT was <= 3 characters, so a local named 'length', 'longest', 'coins' or 'perm' could be offered alone and never combined; (2) it replaced its pool with each level's output, so an atom could never be combined with a composite -- which is exactly the shape of all three published fixes.
corrects.the_sentence_that_was_wrong: where_it_stops.meaning: 'the failing case is not fixed by any expression the site's own material can build, so the fix is not one expression at one site'
corrects.what_is_now_unresolved_rather_than_answe: with both defects repaired and 6000 candidates offered per site (about 1 s each), none of the three published fixes is offered. The correct verdict is UNRESOLVED, not IMPOSSIBLE.
corrects.why_it_was_wrong: the corpus says otherwise. lis: 'longest = length + 1' -> 'longest = max(longest, length + 1)'. next_permutation: 'if perm[j] < perm[i]:' -> 'if perm[i] < perm[j]:'. possible_change: 'if total < 0:' -> 'if total < 0 or not coins:'. Every one is one expression over names and operators already at the site.

defects: pool replaced instead of cumulative at each level
_size counted AST context nodes (Load/Store), so a name measured 2 and only constants were atoms
the site's own sub-expressions were not material
the site's own expression was excluded from its own pool

summary.reading: A fix that is offered is a completeness witness for that site: the pool can build it, so any earlier 'not expressible' verdict about this site was a claim about the code. A fix that is not offered within the cap is unresolved, not impossible.

the_arithmetic_of_why_blind_enumeration_.forms_per_pair: ~45 (arithmetic, comparison, boolean, subscript, slice, literals, builtin calls)
the_arithmetic_of_why_blind_enumeration_.where_the_three_fixes_live: size 5-6 (atom x composite, or composite x composite)

the_rule_this_establishes: An insufficiency claim is a claim about the world; a failure to find is a claim about the code. Publish the witness or say unresolved -- and when a witness is published, publish both predicates: accepted by the corpus, and correct on inputs the corpus never saw.
title: The fix was in the pool all along: five generator defects, not a limit of the language, and one corpus-accepted false positive
